notes.title: Item Comparison Added
notes.content: This is a small, but very useful update that adds a new box for comparing items in the inventory screen. The window can be opened and closed by pressing TAB in the inventory menu.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
This patch includes some small bug fixes that were reported by the community. Thank you to those who have shared their thoughts and feedback! 

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the random mods for dungeons would reroll when opening certain other UI Menus.
[*] Fixed an issue where the character could become stuck on a wall when using a travel skill. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the Novice's Necklace's Intelligence modifier would override other items' bonuses. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the Dungeon Level could not be adjusted while on the Dungeon Menu in the Infinite Dungeon. You will still be unable to lower the level of the dungeon below the highest level chosen in the current run without resetting the dungeon.
[/list]

As always, if you find any issues with the new patch, be sure to let us know either on the official Discord or on the Steam Discussion Board. If you haven't joined the official Geeky Goblin Games Discord server, you can do so here: https://discord.gg/DUXttE7MPC


Enjoy!

notes.title: Item Filters are Here!
notes.content:
Item Filtering is here, making it much easier to farm for the items you want and ignore the ones you don't. This patch also includes some bug fixes and under-the-hood improvements. 


[list]
[*] Item Filters have been added! They can be edited through the pause menu. 
[*] Items can now be filtered by base type and by stats. Stat Filtering also allows you to highlight items with particularly interesting mods. 
[*] Item Filter Settings are now saved per character. 
[*] Fixed a bug where the Infinite Dungeon level would reset to 1 when starting a new run. It will now default to your level. 

[/list]
Thank you to everyone who has supported the game. If you enjoy Another Dungeon Game, please consider leaving an honest review on the Steam Store page. Reviews help the game to reach more people and help our small community grow. 

Until next time, 
Jack

notes.title: Partial Controller Support Update
notes.content:
For a while now, the most requested feature request I have received from the community has been Controller Support. This update brings the introduction of Partial Controller Support, meaning that you can control your character during gameplay with a gamepad now, but you still need to use a mouse/keyboard in the User Interface. 

This patch also includes some small bug fixes. 

[list]
[*] Partial Controller Support has been added! 
[*] The ability to set you control scheme type has been added to the Settings menu and the New Character menu. 
[/list]

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you could get stuck talking to the tutorial NPC. 
[/list]

As always, if you find any issues with the new patch, be sure to let us know either on the official Discord or on the Steam Discussion Board. If you haven't joined the official Geeky Goblin Games Discord server, you can do so here: https://discord.gg/DUXttE7MPC


Enjoy!

notes.title: Early Access Update 1
notes.content:
The first patch following our Early Access launch is here, fixing a few visual issues in the game. 

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the boss health bars would sometimes be hidden behind walls in the Infinite Dungeon. 
[*] Fixed an issue where loot would draw over the player sprite. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the training zombies would draw over the player sprite. 
[*] Adjusted the draw order of enemies to reflect the above changes. 
[/list]

As always, if you find any issues with the new patch, be sure to let us know either on the official Discord or on the Steam Discussion Board.

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.content:
Welcome to Early Access! Today, Another Dungeon Game was released to the public, bringing with it a big content update. I'll leave most of the new content as a surprise, but the town, the beginning of the main story quest, and many QoL changes have been added! 

Check out Another Dungeon Game today while it's 10% off, and make sure to share your feedback so we can make the game the best it can be!

notes.title: Optimization Patch!
notes.content:
Today I released a small but very important patch filled with optimization improvements! The game's performance has been significantly improved now. During testing, I was unable to get the game to lag or drop frames even during fast, high-level gameplay. Please report any performance issues on the official Discord or the Steam Discussion Board. 


Here are some patch notes: 
[list]
[*] Performance has been significantly improved! 
[*] A few items with small mod pools have had new mods added to their pools. 

[/list]
Thank you to everyone who has supported Another Dungeon Game so far. If you aren't a part of the Alpha and want to get your hands on the game as soon as possible, please WISHLIST the game on Steam so that you can be notified when we launch. Growing our Wishlist numbers will play a part in when we release, so help spread the word, and we can hit Early Access faster! 

Until next time, 
Jack

notes.title: Even More Infinite Dungeon!
notes.content:
I am happy to announce that today's Alpha update brings some big changes to the Infinite Dungeon. Now you can dive deeper and deeper into the dungeon, facing more powerful foes and getting better loot along the way. This update also introduces boss enemies into the game, which will appear on every third floor of the Infinite Dungeon and must be slain before moving to the next floor. 

Here is an example of what the mods in your dungeon could look like: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42441935/5583c2ab99d3bf50ae140bf15a5f391eadb8177d.png[/img]

Here are some patch notes: 

[list]
[*] Boss Enemies have been added to the Infinite Dungeon, appearing on every third floor. 
[*] You can now set what level to run the Infinite Dungeon at. The current cap is level 200 (good luck getting that high). 
[*] You can now continue an Infinite Dungeon run even after returning to town or exiting the game. 
[*] Enemies automatically gain more damage and health per floor, but the chance for magic and rare items to drop also improves with each floor. Remember that mods can be seen by pressing TAB while in the Infinite Dungeon. 
[*] Your Infinite Dungeon can be reset to floor 1 by either using the new reset button, dying, or returning to town from the pause menu rather than the Infinite Dungeon menu after completing the floor. 
[*] Enemies and looting have had some under-the-hood work that has fixed several issues and rebalanced looting to make slightly fewer but more valuable drops. 
[/list]

Thank you to everyone who has supported Another Dungeon Game so far. If you aren't a part of the Alpha and want to get your hands on the game as soon as possible, please WISHLIST the game on Steam so that you can be notified when we launch. Growing our Wishlist numbers will play a part in when we release, so help spread the word, and we can hit Early Access faster! 

Until next time, 
Jackobuddy

notes.title: Item Requirements Added!
notes.content:
The latest update for Another Dungeon Game is out, introducing stat requirements for items. Equipment that you do not meet the requirements for will now be highlighted in red on the inventory screen, and the necessary stats can be found in the item description. An update for the public demo has been released as well, so everyone can try the new system out. Please report any bugs on the official Discord or through the Steam Discussion Boards. 

Have fun!

notes.title: New Loot System is Out!
notes.content:
The latest update for Another Dungeon Game is here for all Alpha Testers, bringing with it a much more interesting loot system! Before, the loot tables would change radically every 4 -5 levels. With the new system, new loot is introduced to the table at each level, while older loot is removed from the table at a similar pace. The current loot tables work up to level 11, with more levels coming very soon! 

This update also introduces a new system for dialogue. The old ugly grey speech boxes are gone, replaced by a more stylistic speech box. More visual improvements will be coming to this system in the future. 

As always, thank you for helping to test the game before we release it to the general public! I cannot wait to show the world what we've made.

notes.title: Shockwave Skill Upgrades have Arrived!
notes.content:
Work continues on fleshing out the Brute class. Today's patch introduces the first Skil Upgrade Tree for the class, Shockwave! Punch your way through walls of foes with this piercing wave of raw power. For Alpha Testers, the build is live now. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42441935/2b9a2119db5e1fc0239332e8f511467093e25c1a.png[/img]

Also in this update is a change to the power of Skill Upgrades. Spending a point on any Skill Upgrade for a skill also grants a passive 10% damage bonus to the skill, for a total bonus of 50% at max tier. This damage increase is additive with other damage multipliers for Skill Upgrades, meaning that taking an upgrade that reduces your damage by 10% will equal a 0% change in damage.

notes.title: The Paladin Passive Tree is Here!
notes.content:
I am happy to announce that the Paladin Passive Tree has been added as the first subclass of the Brute! Bringing a range of defensive options as well as some powerful offensive choices, the Paladin is sure to get the attention of any hero who likes blocking, retaliating, and even Smiting their enemy into a pile of ash! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42441935/59fb4cb8dfb4f791357935620f1fe39273490aad.png[/img]

The Paladin is live now on the current Alpha Build for testing. As usual, please submit any feedback or bug reports either on the Official Discord Server or on the Steam Discussion board. 

[h2]So What's Next... [/h2]

So glad you asked! The plan moving forward is to begin work on the Skill Upgrades for the Brute Class. Once these are done, we will have two fully operational classes, The Wizard with two subclasses and The Brute with one. From there, work will begin on The Ranger class! 

While the classes are being built, work is also being done to add new enemy types, and bosses are getting closer as well. The main thing holding back the addition of random boss fights to the game is the need for more interesting and diverse enemy skills. As we approach the release of boss enemies, expect more of these skills to appear within the game. 

Thank you for all the support from both the Alpha Testers and those who have begun to follow the game on Steam! I hope to announce soon when the public will have their first chance to play a demo of the game, but in the meantime, don't forget to add the game to your Wishlist and tell your friends about Another Dungeon Game. This is a small title and won't go very far without the support of the community.

notes.content:

[b]NEW PASSIVES[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Passive: Bodybuilder, which grants additional Strength per level. 
[*] Added Passive: Healthy, which grants Constitution per level. 
[/list]

[b]ARTWORK[/b]
[list]
[*] Added several new icons to represent passive skills. 
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]

[/list]
